BeginIntegrationDeliveryRead.temperatureReason: Delivery scheduler reads the selected delivery and connection on every worker tick.
BeginIntegrationDeliveryRead.reason: One installed-source capture checks HIPAACompliance, then reads the first delivery by ID. For retryable deliveries it selects the first matching connection and the four configuration keys used by the sender. Legacy mode copies these headers under the workspace lock and bounded mode holds them under a read owner. TestDeliveryOutcomesDifferential covers refusal order, duplicate IDs, endpoint and credential selection, and peer edits before claim.
